name: Account Choice Method 1 Code
definition: Method used by the cardholder and the terminal for the choice of the account.

ACSL.name: Account Selected
ACSL.definition: Account selected in an account list.

ENTR.name: Entered
ENTR.definition: Account identification is entered by the customer.

IMAC.name: Implicit Account
IMAC.definition: Account is selected according to the configuration.

IMPL.name: Implicit Type
IMPL.definition: Type of account is selected according to the configuration.

NOSL.name: No Selection
NOSL.definition: Account is not selected by the customer or a profile, but by the issuer.

TPSL.name: Type Selected
TPSL.definition: Type of account selected in a list.
